problem:
Problem description
- There is a finite planning horizon of $$T$$ periods indexed by $$t \in \mathcal{T}=\{1,\ldots,T\}$$.
- There are $$N$$ investment opportunities indexed by $$j \in \mathcal{J}=\{1,\ldots,N\}$$.
- The decision maker starts with initial liquid capital $$C_0$$ at the beginning of period $$1$$.
- Each opportunity $$j$$ has an allowed opening set $$\mathcal{A}_j \subseteq \mathcal{T}$$, a lock-up duration $$d_j$$, a gross return multiplier $$\rho_j$$, a per-unit cash requirement $$c_j$$, and a maximum cumulative investment limit $$U_j$$.
- Capital invested in an opportunity is tied up until the opportunity matures, after which the principal and return are released back into liquid capital.
- Any liquid capital not invested in a period may be carried forward and used later.
- Investments may only be made in periods when the corresponding opportunity is open, and the total amount placed into any opportunity may not exceed its investment limit.
- The available liquid capital in any period cannot be exceeded by the total new investments initiated in that period.
- The planning goal is to choose the investment amounts over all periods so that the terminal capital at the end of $$T$$ is maximized.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_{j,t}$$, the amount invested in opportunity $$j$$ at the beginning of period $$t$$.
  - $$h_t$$, the liquid capital available at the relevant reporting point of period $$t$$.
  - $$Z_T$$, the total capital available at the end of period $$T$$.

Input Format
{
  "T": "planning horizon length, scalar $$T$$",
  "C0": "initial liquid capital at the beginning of period $$1$$, scalar $$C_0$$",
  "N": "number of investment opportunities, scalar $$N$$",
  "projects": [
    {
      "id": "project index $$j$$",
      "open_periods": "set $$\mathcal{A}_j \subseteq \mathcal{T}$$ of periods when a new investment may start",
      "maturity_lag": "lock-up duration $$d_j$$ in periods before capital is released",
      "unit_cash_requirement": "cash requirement per unit invested, scalar $$c_j$$",
      "gross_return": "gross return multiplier $$\rho_j$$ applied at maturity",
      "max_investment": "capacity limit $$U_j$$ on the total amount that can be invested in project $$j$$"
    }
  ]
}

Output Format
{
  "investment_plan": "array $$x_{j,t}$$ with shape $$N \\times T$$; each entry is the planned amount invested in opportunity $$j$$ at the beginning of period $$t$$",
  "liquid_capital_path": "array $$h_t$$ with shape $$T+1$$; each entry is the liquid capital available at the chosen reporting point of period $$t$$",
  "terminal_capital": "scalar $$Z_T$$; the total capital at the end of period $$T$$"
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "T": 3,
  "C0": 300000,
  "N": 4,
  "projects": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "open_periods": [1, 2, 3],
      "maturity_lag": 1,
      "unit_cash_requirement": 1,
      "gross_return": 1.2,
      "max_investment": null
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "open_periods": [1],
      "maturity_lag": 2,
      "unit_cash_requirement": 1,
      "gross_return": 1.5,
      "max_investment": 150000
    },
    {
      "id": 3,
      "open_periods": [2],
      "maturity_lag": 2,
      "unit_cash_requirement": 1,
      "gross_return": 1.6,
      "max_investment": 200000
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "open_periods": [3],
      "maturity_lag": 1,
      "unit_cash_requirement": 1,
      "gross_return": 1.4,
      "max_investment": 100000
    }
  ]
}

parameters.name: planning_horizon_t
parameters.description: Number of periods in the finite planning horizon

parameters.name: initial_liquid_capital
parameters.description: Initial liquid capital at the beginning of period 1

parameters.name: allowed_open_periods
parameters.description: Allowed opening periods for each opportunity j

parameters.name: gross_return_multiplier
parameters.description: Gross return multiplier for each opportunity

parameters.name: unit_cash_requirement
parameters.description: Per-unit cash requirement for each opportunity

parameters.name: max_investment_limit
parameters.description: Maximum cumulative investment limit for each opportunity, possibly unbounded if no limit is imposed

variables.name: investment_amount
variables.description: Amount invested in opportunity j at the beginning of period t

variables.name: liquid_capital_path
variables.description: Liquid capital available at each reporting point from period 0 through period T

variables.name: terminal_capital
variables.description: Total capital available at the end of period T

constraints.name: nonnegative_liquid_capital
constraints.description: Liquid capital values must be nonnegative

constraints.name: open_period_restriction
constraints.description: Investments may only be initiated in allowed opening periods for each opportunity

constraints.name: opportunity_investment_cap
constraints.description: Total investment in each opportunity over the horizon may not exceed its maximum investment limit

constraints.name: period_liquidity_limit
constraints.description: Total new investments initiated in any period cannot exceed liquid capital available in that period

constraints.name: capital_carry_forward
constraints.description: Liquid capital evolves by carrying forward unused capital from the previous period and adding matured investment proceeds at the start of each period
constraints.formula: h_t = h_{t-1} - \sum_{j=1}^{N} x_{j,t-1} + \sum_{j=1}^{N} \sum_{\tau=1}^{t-1} \mathbf{1}_{\{\tau + d_j = t\}}\, \rho_j x_{j,\tau} \quad \forall t=1,\ldots,T

constraints.name: maturity_release
constraints.description: Invested capital is released back into liquid capital exactly after the corresponding lock-up duration with gross return, enforced through the period-to-period capital balance

constraints.name: terminal_capital_reporting
constraints.description: Terminal capital equals liquid capital at the end of period T

constraints.name: opportunity_opening_restriction
constraints.description: Investments may only be initiated in allowed opening periods for each opportunity

constraints.name: initial_capital_condition
constraints.description: Liquid capital at the start of period 0 equals the initial capital

objectives.name: terminal_capital_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize terminal capital at the end of period T

final_objective.description: Maximize terminal capital at the end of period T.
